title: Custom Cache Resolvers
description: Implement custom cache resolvers for complex data relationships and denormalization in Apollo Client.

data.text: Apollo cache is normalized, meaning related objects are stored separately and references are used to link them. Sometimes you need to manually resolve these references or compute derived data. Custom cache resolvers let you define how to traverse relationships and compute values on the client side.

data.title: Custom cache resolver
data.content: Custom resolver for a query field.

data.text: Use `cache.identify()` to get the cache identifier for an object, and `cache.modify()` to update specific fields without overwriting the entire object. This is essential for denormalizing data from mutations.
Be careful with circular references in custom resolvers. Apollo has a depth limit to prevent infinite loops. Keep resolver logic simple and declarative.
data.title: Circular References
Custom Cache Resolvers Key Points
points: Resolvers compute derived data from the cache.
cache.identify() gets the cache key for an object.
Use resolvers for client-only computed fields.
data.takeaway: Custom cache resolvers extend Apollo Client beyond simple storage into a lightweight client-side graph.
